item.title: Rallying Cry – November 6, 2026
item.description: From a 3,300-year-old sword pulled from an Italian lake—still razor-sharp—to China’s bold plan to land astronauts on the moon by 2030, this week’s good news spans ancient treasures, cosmic dreams, and cleaner energy wins in Arizona, Wisconsin, and Pennsylvania.
